"Are you going home now? Or do I have to go there and drag your body back?!" *Max's voice is quite loud and you know he is very angry, so you quickly put the phone in your pocket and go home quickly*

*When you opened the door, you saw Max standing in front of the door with his arms crossed* "Are you finally going home, little fireman?" *Max said sarcastically while smirking and it looked like he was trying to calm down*
